serviceBases: Core /api, Strategy /strategy-api, Workspace /workspace-api appended to approved actual configured origins; browser Portfolio proxy and fixed Modules gateway remain canonical. No live origin is supplied/guessed.

identity_clients.semantics: Current tenant/user and readable client verification; query clientId is a selection hint, never authority. Preserve current ApplicationBoundary replacement.

meetings.semantics: Core allocation despite operation/path legacy Engagement naming; clientId optional for Master, from/to bounds. Controller standard_user role; current meeting/client access remains server-owned.

planner.semantics: Canonical Planner, not Core engagement.tasks. Paginated items/nextCursor; no native public client/date query filters on tasks. Read exact task by ID even outside current page/My tasks. ACL/access returned by current owner; do not create/edit to satisfy a drilldown. Start/due civil fields retain their own dates/times/zones.

master_feeds.semantics: Keep independent source outcomes, search/source/range filters and partial-coverage warnings; extras are existing Master Agenda composition, not invented client-wide feeds. meetings403 must not erase successful independent feeds.

signature.semantics: Current actor html nullable/enabled boolean. Preview must safely present this actor signature according to checkbox/policy; no remote image/resource load or HTML execution needed. PUT is separate optional setup, not needed with pre-provisioned signature.

rewrite.semantics: Existing outreach_generate governed LLM action. Local Undo does not dispatch another rewrite or mail/send. Native successful rewrite is a paid/provider effect and requires separate explicit authorization; local controlled responses do not constitute native model acceptance.

work.semantics: Strategy detail must match client and strategy; Workspace all means own plus active collaborators, not tenant-wide. Preserve legacy client-name ambiguity refusal and prospect exclusion; owner text never expands record permission. Workspace ownerId comes from clerkUserId; Strategy default owner is clerkUserId and node ownerUserId is an optional string, not an asserted Core UUID.

owner_members.receipt: array {id,clerkUserId,email,name}; active memberships in current tenant only
owner_members.semantics: Exact clerkUserId equality is the verified bridge. No guessed UUID/email/name mapping. Native UsersController has no endpoint admin-only/standard_user annotation; global verified Clerk/tenant/active-membership middleware still applies. Missing/ambiguous/denied roster must preserve unresolved display and hide stale roster; null owner is unassigned, not an unresolved nonempty ID. Core client-account-owners/options has only Core UUIDs and cannot alone resolve Clerk owner IDs.

prospect_files.semantics: Exact actor tenant/prospect list, unique IDs, clientId/meetingId/mailMessageId null; readiness and viewer access remain current. Local search filters only loaded authorized filenames/available supported fields; no new backend search route, upload, rewrite, extraction or storage traversal.

client_delete.receipt: DELETE {ok:true}; scoped GET current attachment collection including lifecycle/readiness
client_delete.semantics: Native marks delete_pending and clears sharing before object delete; S3 failure leaves inaccessible delete_failed and 503, recoverable on same ID; completed row removal gives later lookup404. Not a durable operation receipt or universal idempotent200. Successful fresh authorized list absence describes current visibility, not proof storage erasure, prior DELETE causality, or indexed-chunk completion. No new recovery endpoint is invented.
